name: Huarong Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Huarong Chemical Co., Ltd. develops and sells potassium and chlorine products in China. The company offers potassium series, including potassium hydroxide flakes, food grade potassium hydroxide, reagent grade potassium hydroxide, electronic-grade potassium hydroxide, powdered potassium hydroxide, potassium fluorosilicate, and electronic chemicals. It also provides water treatment chemicals, such as sodium hypochlorite, industrial grade polyaluminum chloride, polyaluminum chloride for drinking water, liquid chlorine, dilute sulfuric acid, and sodium hydroxide.
